findings.text: Socket cgroup lifecycle provides allocation, duplication and release operations that accept socket accounting state and have no observable effect in this configuration.

Task frozen reporting has two configurations: one reflects a per task frozen indicator, while the other always reports unfrozen with empty enter and leave operations that ignore the persistence request.
Group BPF association counting either adjusts a reference held alongside the group or does nothing, depending on build configuration.
Device memory accounting defines a reclaim callback taking pool state, desired byte count and private context, plus a registration record carrying region size, callback table and private context.
Disabled device memory handling reports an absent region on registration, ignores unregistration and release, clears charge outputs while reporting success.
Disabled device memory policy always treats eviction candidates as valuable, never reports below minimum or low thresholds, returns absent ancestry and ignores pool release.
Cgroup namespace record embeds a generic namespace header and links owning user context, usage accounting and root coordination state.
Conversion from a generic namespace header to its enclosing cgroup namespace follows container linkage.
Namespace reference handling either uses generic increment with conditional release and final cleanup, or provides inert get, put and free operations where duplication returns its input unchanged.
RDMA accounting embeds subsystem state with a resource pool list and separate global and local event handles, while device records maintain membership links with a textual name and numeric index.
RDMA resource classification distinguishes handle consumption from object consumption followed by a sentinel marking category count, ordered increasingly from zero.

Subsystem state reference interface offers single and bulk acquisition, best effort acquisition usable with read side protection, online restricted acquisition, and single plus bulk release, all published for external use.
When the no reference marker is present, all acquisition and release operations skip underlying counting and best effort attempts report success.
Bulk acquisition expects an existing hold, while best effort variants accept mere accessibility with distinct offline tolerant versus online only behavior, so incorrect pairing risks imbalance.
Processor descriptor stores node affinity and hotplug capability together with an embedded device representation.
Processor lifecycle notification values place online at two, preparation at three, dead at seven, frozen timeout at eight, completed removal at nine and faulty stop at eleven.
In minimal configuration the frozen task count is zero, map update bracketing is inert, and processor addition with dead sibling rescan report success.
Secondary processor power control either selects a target based on sleep capability before freezing with thaw on resume, or uses inert thaw where suspend and resume report success.
Architecture finalization and idle termination reporting hooks perform no action.

Threat direction enumeration orders user against kernel, user against user, guest against host and guest against guest with a count terminator, while threading mitigation offers disabled, automatic and enabled selections.
Mitigation status queries report protections disabled, never trigger automatic threading shutdown, never show any direction mitigated, with global threading control fixed to disabled.
Power notifications cycle through single unit entry, entry failure and exit, alongside domain level entry, entry failure and exit.
Notifier management and entry exit requests for both single unit and domain uniformly indicate success without action.

Affinity mapping table combines a shared hold count, capacity, object pointer list and trailing per processor records pairing destination index with distance cost, where the largest sixteen bit value denotes infinity.
Affinity queries derive a destination index from per processor records and then resolve the associated object through the object list.
Interrupt affinity table creation accepts a capacity and returns a table handle using kernel allocation priority.
Threading control states enumerate active, inactive, forced inactive, unsupported hardware and unimplemented software support.
Fallback threading control fixes state to unimplemented with a single thread, ignores disable and sizing requests, reports threading unavailable and indicates success for enable or disable.
Feature reporting formats values as text with the platform identifier as the underlying source.
Feature gated module loading declares a terminated match table, publishes it for discovery, fails initialization when the feature is absent and otherwise delegates to the supplied routine.
Frequency naming permits sixteen characters plus termination, with default switch latency equal to one millisecond expressed in nanoseconds.

Coordination modes encode isolated as zero, hardware managed as one, all members as two and any member as three, while selection preferences encode at or above as zero, at or below as one and nearest as two.

Frequency metadata distinguishes unordered from ascending and descending tables, carries per processor limits with switch latency, bundles creation parameters of info table owner and bounds, and records transitions with owning policy plus prior new values and driver flags.

Frequency policy aggregates sharing masks, managing processor, clock source, capability info, bounds with current and suspend points, current prior and governor selections with private data and history, deferred work, constraint and quality requests, table with ordering, list linkage with object lifetime, fast path strictness efficiency delay remote and boost controls with pending updates, cached resolutions, transition coordination with statistics, driver private storage, thermal linkage and bound notifiers.
Policy readers hold shared protection while writers and removal hold exclusive protection; transitions add exclusive spin coordination with sleeping waiters and an owner marker plus progress flag.
Policy lookup by processor yields absent handles with inert release, while frequency readings yield zero, invariance is unsupported, and global disable with limit refresh do nothing.
Automatic cleanup releases policy holds when present; emptiness of the online set means inactive while presence of a second member within range means shared.
Mask word access reaches the underlying storage, ordered set bit search delegates to a bit finder with bounds validation that warns once in debug builds on overflow.
Load pressure either observes a per processor accumulator with single read guarantees or constantly yields zero.
Frequency statistics handling ignores table creation, destruction and transition recording.
Each header defines a unique inclusion marker preventing repeated processing across device memory, namespace, interconnect, processor, power, affinity, threading, feature and frequency facilities.
